<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Sohan Rana — AI, HCI &amp; NLP | 3D Portfolio</title>
<meta name="description" content="Sohan Rana: Software Engineer, Co-founder &amp; COO of Honqio . AI, Human-Computer Interaction, NLP and responsible technology. Explore projects, publications, blog, notices and hire info in an interactive 3D portfolio.">
<meta property="og:title" content="Sohan Rana — Interactive 3D Portfolio">
<meta property="og:description" content="Projects, research, publications, blog, notices and hiring info. Walk through the office and personal room.">

<style>
:root{--bg:#070c18;--panel:#0f192e;--panel2:#132039;--line:rgba(160,185,230,.18);--text:#eaf0fb;--muted:#93a3c0;--blue:#5b9dff;--gold:#d9b872;--gold2:#f0d9a3;--mint:#5ad6c0}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
canvas{display:block;position:fixed;inset:0}
button{font-family:inherit}
a{color:var(--blue)}
#load{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;background:var(--bg);display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;font-family:monospace;color:var(--gold);transition:opacity .6s}
#load small{display:block;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px}
/* top bar */
#top{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:10;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 18px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(7,12,24,.92),rgba(7,12,24,0))}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--text)}
.brand img{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 20%;border:2px solid var(--gold)}
.brand b{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.1rem;display:block;line-height:1.1}
.brand span{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--muted);font-family:monospace;letter-spacing:.04em}
.tb{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:rgba(15,25,46,.88);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:9px 15px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.8rem;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;transition:.2s;white-space:nowrap}
.btn:hover,.btn.on{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold2)}
.btn.hire{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--gold));color:#2a1f08;border-color:transparent;font-weight:600}
.btn.hire:hover{color:#2a1f08;filter:brightness(1.08)}
/* menu */
#menu{position:fixed;left:16px;top:70px;z-index:11;width:250px;max-height:calc(100% - 150px);overflow:auto;background:rgba(15,25,46,.96);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:16px;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);transform:translateX(-120%);transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
#menu.open{transform:none}
#menu h4{font-family:monospace;font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin:12px 0 6px}
#menu h4:first-child{margin-top:0}
#menu button{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;background:none;border:0;color:var(--muted);padding:7px 10px;border-radius:9px;font-size:.86rem;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}
#menu button:hover{background:rgba(91,157,255,.1);color:var(--text)}
#menu button.on{color:var(--gold2);background:rgba(217,184,114,.1)}
/* info panel */
#panel{position:fixed;right:18px;top:70px;bottom:78px;width:min(400px,calc(100% - 36px));z-index:9;background:rgba(15,25,46,.95);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:26px 24px;overflow:auto;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);transform:translateX(120%);transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
#panel.open{transform:none}
.k{font-family:monospace;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px}
h2.pt{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.55rem;margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.15;padding-right:26px}
.body p,.body li{color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.7}
.body p+p{margin-top:10px}
.body ul{margin:8px 0 0 18px}
.body .s{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
.item{padding:13px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.item:first-child{border-top:0}
.item>b{color:var(--text);display:block;font-size:.97rem;margin-bottom:2px}
.item p{font-size:.88rem}
.item .meta{font-family:monospace;font-size:.66rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:3px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
.t{display:inline-block;font-family:monospace;font-size:.64rem;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:2px 9px;border-radius:99px;margin:7px 5px 0 0;color:var(--mint)}
.t.st{color:var(--gold2);border-color:rgba(217,184,114,.4)}
.lnk{display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;margin-right:12px;font-size:.82rem}
.ph{width:100%;max-width:210px;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 18%;border-radius:18px;border:2px solid var(--gold);margin-bottom:14px;display:block}
.cta{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px;padding:11px 20px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--gold));color:#2a1f08!important;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;font-size:.88rem}
.kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:96px 1fr;gap:6px 12px;margin-top:14px;font-size:.86rem}
.kv span{color:var(--gold);font-family:monospace;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.06em;padding-top:2px}
.kv div{color:var(--text)}
#x{position:absolute;top:14px;right:16px;background:none;border:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:1.3rem;cursor:pointer}
/* bottom bar */
#bar{position:fixed;bottom:16px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:8;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
#hint{position:fixed;bottom:62px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;z-index:7;color:var(--muted);font-size:.74rem;font-family:monospace;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .6s}
#cur{font-family:monospace;font-size:.74rem;color:var(--gold2);min-width:130px;text-align:center}
/* classic view */
#classic{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:30;background:var(--bg);overflow:auto;display:none}
#classic.show{display:block}
#classic .wrap{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px 80px}
#classic header{display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px 1fr;gap:34px;align-items:center;padding:70px 0 40px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
#classic header img{width:200px;height:200px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 18%;border:3px solid var(--gold)}
#classic header h1{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,3.4rem);line-height:1.05;margin-bottom:8px}
#classic header p{color:var(--muted);max-width:560px}
#classic .row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px}
#classic .avail{display:inline-block;font-family:monospace;font-size:.7rem;color:var(--mint);border:1px solid rgba(90,214,192,.35);padding:5px 12px;border-radius:99px;margin-bottom:14px}
#classic section{padding:44px 0 6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
#classic section:last-child{border:0}
#classic .grp{font-family:monospace;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;padding-top:44px}
#classic .topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 24px;background:rgba(7,12,24,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
#classic .body{padding-bottom:30px}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .brand span{display:none}
  #top{padding:10px 12px}
  #panel{left:10px;right:10px;width:auto;top:auto;bottom:70px;max-height:58vh;height:auto}
  #menu{left:10px;top:64px;width:calc(100% - 20px)}
  .btn.opt{display:none}
  #hint{display:none}
  #classic header{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center;justify-items:center;padding-top:40px}
}
</style>
</head>

function mat(c,r,m){return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:c,roughness:r==null?.8:r,metalness:m||0})}
function box(w,h,d,c,x,y,z,o){var m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d),(o&&o.m)||mat(c,o&&o.r,o&&o.me));m.position.set(x,y,z);scene.add(m);return m}
function cyl(rt,rb,h,c,x,y,z,seg){var m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rt,rb,h,seg||20),mat(c));m.position.set(x,y,z);scene.add(m);return m}
function tex(w,h,draw){var c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;var g=c.getContext('2d');draw(g,w,h);var t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);t.anisotropy=4;return t}
function rr(g,x,y,w,h,r){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x+r,y);g.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);g.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);g.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);g.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);g.closePath()}
function wrap(g,text,x,y,maxW,lh,maxLines){var words=text.split(' '),line='',n=0;for(var i=0;i<words.length;i++){var t=line+words[i]+' ';if(g.measureText(t).width>maxW&&line){g.fillText(line,x,y);y+=lh;line=words[i]+' ';if(++n>=maxLines-1){}}else line=t}g.fillText(line,x,y);return y}
function screenMat(title,lines,bg,fg){
  return new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:tex(512,320,function(g,w,h){
    g.fillStyle=bg||'#0b1324';g.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
    g.fillStyle=fg||'#d9b872';g.font='bold 34px Georgia';g.fillText(title,26,58);
    g.fillStyle='#8ec0ff';g.font='22px monospace';
    (lines||[]).forEach(function(l,i){g.fillText(l,26,108+i*38)});
  })})}
function plane(w,h,m,x,y,z,ry){var p=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w,h),m);p.position.set(x,y,z);p.rotation.y=ry||0;scene.add(p);return p}
function basic(map){return new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:map})}

function board(title,items,x,y,z,side,w,h,accent){
  box(.06,h+.12,w+.12,0x7a5230,x,y,z);
  var m=basic(tex(512,Math.round(512*h/w),function(g,W2,H2){
    g.fillStyle='#b88a56';g.fillRect(0,0,W2,H2);
    for(var i=0;i<900;i++){g.fillStyle='rgba(90,55,20,'+(Math.random()*.18)+')';g.fillRect(Math.random()*W2,Math.random()*H2,2,2)}
    g.fillStyle='#0b1324';g.fillRect(0,0,W2,64);g.fillStyle=accent;g.font='bold 34px Georgia';g.fillText(title,20,44);
    var cols=['#fff4a8','#bfe3ff','#ffd0d6','#c9f2c7'];
    items.slice(0,4).forEach(function(it,i){
      var cx=18+(i%2)*(W2/2-6),cy=84+Math.floor(i/2)*((H2-96)/2);
      g.save();g.translate(cx,cy);g.rotate((i%2?1:-1)*.03);
      g.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.25)';g.fillRect(4,4,W2/2-30,(H2-96)/2-14);
      g.fillStyle=cols[i%4];g.fillRect(0,0,W2/2-30,(H2-96)/2-14);
      g.fillStyle='#c0392b';g.beginPath();g.arc((W2/2-30)/2,10,6,0,7);g.fill();
      g.fillStyle='#2a2a2a';g.font='bold 21px sans-serif';wrap(g,it.s,12,40,W2/2-54,25,3);
      g.restore()});
  }));
  plane(w,h,m,x+side*-.035,y,z,side>0?-Math.PI/2:Math.PI/2);
}

function label(txt,x,y,z,id){
  var t=tex(256,64,function(g,w,h){g.fillStyle='rgba(11,19,36,.88)';rr(g,2,2,w-4,h-4,20);g.fill();g.strokeStyle='#d9b872';g.lineWidth=2.5;g.stroke();g.fillStyle='#f0d9a3';g.font='bold 27px sans-serif';g.textAlign='center';g.textBaseline='middle';g.fillText(txt,w/2,h/2+1)});
  var s=new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({map:t,transparent:true}));s.scale.set(1.0,.25,1);s.position.set(x,y+.34,z);s.userData.id=id;scene.add(s);hitObjs.push(s)}
spots.forEach(function(s){
  var m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.12,16,16),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xf0d9a3}));
  m.position.set(s[1],s[2],s[3]);m.userData.id=s[0];scene.add(m);
  var halo=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.22,16,16),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xd9b872,transparent:true,opacity:.25}));
  halo.position.copy(m.position);halo.userData.id=s[0];scene.add(halo);hs.push(halo);hitObjs.push(m,halo);
  label(s[4],s[1],s[2],s[3],s[0]);
});
}else{
  var views={office:{}};
}

var menu=$('#menu'),panel=$('#panel');
groups.forEach(function(g){
  var h=document.createElement('h4');h.textContent=g[0];menu.appendChild(h);
  g[1].forEach(function(id){var b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=names[id];b.dataset.v=id;b.onclick=function(){go(id);menu.classList.remove('open')};menu.appendChild(b)});
});
function mark(id){[].forEach.call(menu.querySelectorAll('button'),function(b){b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.v===id)});$('#cur').textContent=names[id]||id}
function go(id){
  if(!names[id])id='office';
  cur=id;mark(id);
  if(has3d){var v=views[id];tgtP.set.apply(tgtP,v.p);tgtL.set.apply(tgtL,v.l)}
  var d=data[id];
  if(d){$('#pc').innerHTML='<div class="k">'+d.k+'</div><h2 class="pt">'+d.t+'</h2><div class="body">'+d.h+'</div>';panel.classList.add('open');panel.scrollTop=0}else panel.classList.remove('open');
  try{history.replaceState(null,'','#'+id)}catch(e){}
}
function step(n){var i=order.indexOf(cur);if(i<0)i=0;go(order[(i+n+order.length)%order.length])}
$('#prev').onclick=function(){step(-1)};$('#next').onclick=function(){step(1)};
$('#x').onclick=function(){panel.classList.remove('open')};
$('#mbtn').onclick=function(){menu.classList.toggle('open')};
$('#hbtn').onclick=function(){go('hire')};
$('.brand').onclick=function(e){e.preventDefault();go('office')};
addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if(e.key==='ArrowRight')step(1);else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')step(-1);
  else if(e.key==='Escape'){panel.classList.remove('open');menu.classList.remove('open');$('#classic').classList.remove('show')}});

/* classic (flat) view */
function buildClassic(){
  var c=$('#classic');if(c.dataset.built)return;c.dataset.built=1;
  var h='<div class="topbar"><b style="font-family:Georgia,serif">Sohan Rana</b><div class="tb">'+(has3d?'<button class="btn" id="back3d">← Back to 3D</button>':'')+'<a class="btn hire" href="'+mail+'?subject=Hiring%20inquiry">Hire me</a></div></div><div class="wrap"><header><img src="'+PHOTO+'" alt="Sohan Rana"><div><span class="avail">OPEN TO INTERNSHIPS &amp; RESEARCH COLLABORATION</span><h1>Sohan Rana</h1><p>Software Engineering student at Daffodil International University and Co-founder &amp; COO of Honqio IT, working on AI, Human-Computer Interaction, NLP and responsible technology.</p><div class="row"><a class="btn" href="'+CFG.github+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">GitHub</a><a class="btn" href="'+CFG.linkedin+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">LinkedIn</a><a class="btn" href="'+CFG.scholar+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Google Scholar</a><a class="btn" href="'+mail+'">Email</a></div></div></header>';
  ['about','projects','publications','research','honqio','services','engage','notices','circulars','hire','edu','skills','blog','contact'].forEach(function(id){
    var d=data[id];h+='<section id="c-'+id+'"><div class="k">'+d.k.split(' · ')[0]+'</div><h2 class="pt">'+d.t+'</h2><div class="body">'+d.h.replace(/<img class="ph"[^>]*>/,'')+'</div></section>'});
  h+='</div>';c.innerHTML=h;
  var b=$('#back3d');if(b)b.onclick=function(){c.classList.remove('show')};
}
$('#cbtn').onclick=function(){buildClassic();$('#classic').classList.add('show')};

/* 3D interaction + loop */
if(has3d){
  var ray=new THREE.Raycaster(),mv=new THREE.Vector2(),down=null;
  addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){look.set((e.clientX/innerWidth-.5)*2,(e.clientY/innerHeight-.5)*2);
    mv.set(e.clientX/innerWidth*2-1,-(e.clientY/innerHeight)*2+1);ray.setFromCamera(mv,cam);
    ren.domElement.style.cursor=ray.intersectObjects(hitObjs).length?'pointer':'default'});
  addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){down=[e.clientX,e.clientY]});
  addEventListener('pointerup',function(e){
    if(!down||e.target!==ren.domElement||Math.abs(e.clientX-down[0])>6||Math.abs(e.clientY-down[1])>6)return;
    mv.set(e.clientX/innerWidth*2-1,-(e.clientY/innerHeight)*2+1);ray.setFromCamera(mv,cam);
    var hit=ray.intersectObjects(hitObjs);if(hit.length)go(hit[0].object.userData.id)});
  addEventListener('resize',function(){cam.aspect=innerWidth/innerHeight;cam.updateProjectionMatrix();ren.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight)});
  (function loop(t){requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    curP.lerp(tgtP,.045);curL.lerp(tgtL,.06);
    cam.position.copy(curP);
    var tl=curL.clone();tl.x+=look.x*.9;tl.y-=look.y*.5;cam.lookAt(tl);
    hs.forEach(function(o,i){o.scale.setScalar(1+Math.sin(t*.003+i)*.18)});
    ren.render(scene,cam)})(0);
}

setTimeout(function(){var hh=$('#hint');if(hh)hh.style.opacity=0},12000);
/* start */
var start=(location.hash||'').slice(1);
setTimeout(function(){
  if(!has3d){buildClassic();$('#classic').classList.add('show');$('#mbtn').style.display='none';$('#bar').style.display='none';$('#hint').style.display='none'}
  else{go(names[start]?start:'office')}
  var l=$('#load');l.style.opacity=0;setTimeout(function(){l.remove()},700);
},600);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
